definitions.explanation: An event of great consequence, usually a troubling one that demands attention at once. It has an old-fashioned, dramatic ring, so it is often used with a touch of humour about everyday upsets.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一大事|いちだいじ}だ。
⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なくす⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{一大事|いちだいじ}⟦じゃないか→じゃないか：29707_janaika⟧。
examples.english: Losing your wallet? That's a big deal!

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一大事|いちだいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{動揺|どうよう}した→動揺する：25352_douyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The staff were shaken by the crisis of the president's sudden resignation.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一大事|いちだいじ}だ: this is serious!
- ⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一大事|いちだいじ}: a national crisis
- {一大事|いちだいじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: something grave happens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧: terrible, serious; the everyday word (⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ！ "Oh no!")
- ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧: important; on its own it rarely means "a crisis" in modern Japanese
